verdict.rationale: CrewAI's own docs call the core product an "open-source framework", and the pack cites the public GitHub repository (crewAIInc/crewAI), so the source is readable. The commercial AMP layer is described separately as an extension. missing for 10: the specific license name or terms (e.g. a LICENSE file or SPDX identifier), and independent or hands-on confirmation of the repository's licensing.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: CrewAI AMP extends the power of the open-source framework with features designed for production deployments, collaboration, and scalability.
It gives developers autonomous agent collaboration through Crews and precise, event-driven control through Flows.
